title: decision
description: A session asks the user one question. The options are suggestions: the user answers in free text.

context.description: Why the question comes up now, and what the user needs to know to answer.

snippet.description: Code or text that shows the problem. Optional.

risk.description: The policy level of this decision.

defaultOption.description: The option that applies if the user gives no answer in time.

waitSeconds.description: 0: return PENDING at once. More than 0: block up to this many seconds.
